text:
maya-support: Heads up — Acme Robotics can't complete payment on invoice INV-2026-0421. They asked to move to Net 60 instead of Net 30 because their AP requires a PO before releasing payments. Card on file was declined earlier and they claim we applied VAT incorrectly for their EU entity. They want service to continue while terms are sorted.

ben-sales: FYI they signed last week. I verbally approved Net 45 during negotiation but legal's contract says Net 30. We offered 2 weeks runway originally. Can we make a one-off Net 60 for this invoice?

alex-finance: Need specifics before approving exceptions — did we receive a signed PO? billing address? tax ID? Also what did the payment gateway return as the error code (expired vs insufficient_funds vs blocked)? Paste the payments dashboard message.

maya-support: Payment error from Stripe: `payment_intent: pi_3Kxxxxx status: requires_payment_method` -> decline_code: `card_declined`. Not expired. Customer says their IT blocked outbound vendor payments until PO is issued. They provided PO number PO-98765 and an EU VAT id: DE123456789. They insist reverse-charge applies and we shouldn't have charged VAT.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0421 snapshot: tax_amount=€1200, subtotal=€6000, total=€7200, vat_applied=true. Actions available: `issue_credit_note`, `reissue_without_vat`, `set_payment_terms`.

lucy-cs: :thinking_face: Acme is strategic for our robotics use-case. Ben, can we offer a temporary grace arrangement (limited quota) so their integration doesn't break while PO is processed? Cutting them off mid-integration will cause churn.

ben-sales: I agree. Proposed compromise: grant Net 60 for this cycle only while they submit PO & VAT docs; require PO + VAT validation before the next invoice. Provide limited access (25% token quota) until PO is confirmed. Customer accepted that verbally.

alex-finance: For an exception to payment terms I need documented approvals: sales needs to submit a written exception request with rationale + duration. Also require either a corporate credit check or a second-level approval from finance. I can approve a one-off Net 60 if sales attaches the exception form and legal signs off. Once VAT is validated we'll reissue the invoice with reverse-charge (0% VAT).

ben-sales: I'll upload the signed exception to JIRA ticket INVOICE-128 and ping legal. @maya-support can you reissue the invoice without VAT and mark terms Net 60 provisional? Add note: 'Service continues under limited quota pending PO.'

maya-support: On it. Running reissue command now:
```
billing reissue --invoice INV-2026-0421 --tax=0 --terms=Net60 --note='Provisional Net60 pending PO'
```
I'll also tag internal note: `hold_access=false quota=25%`.

billing-bot: Action completed: INV-2026-0421 -> INV-2026-0421-R1 issued. New tax_amount=€0, subtotal=€6000, total=€6000, terms=Net60 (provisional). Status: sent_to_buyer. Audit ref: audit_5761.

alex-finance: Good. Please confirm PO-98765 and VAT id validation before next billing cycle. Also finance policy: exceptions >60 days require VP Finance sign-off — won't accept repeated Net60s without credit terms review.

lucy-cs: Customer uploaded PO-98765 and VAT cert to their procurement portal and emailed us the attachment. They say their AP process is Net60. I'll watch for validation from our tax team.

ben-sales: Thanks team. @alex-finance I'll attach the signed exception form into JIRA and request legal sign-off ASAP. @maya-support confirm when quota limits are enforced so they can resume full integration testing if needed.

maya-support: Quota limited to 25% and applied to their org keys. Service endpoints remain reachable for integration tests. I'll update the thread when exception doc is in JIRA. :white_check_mark:

alex-finance: Once JIRA has the exception + legal sign-off and we validate VAT id (DE123456789) we mark the invoice final. If VAT is invalid we will reapply tax and issue a credit request to the customer.

maya-support: Noted. Closing loop when all docs in place.
